# Acqron

## What is Acqron?

Acqron is a software development company based in Bacolod City, Philippines. We specialize in building custom internal tools, client portals, workflow automation systems, and web platforms for professional services firms — specifically real estate brokerages, law firms, and accounting practices.

We began by building for real estate and short-term rental management companies across the United States, and we now serve both US and Philippine clients.

## Who we build for

- **Real Estate & Rental Firms** — property and listing management systems, tenant portals, lead tracking tools, booking platforms, and rental automation software
- **Law Firms** — practice management software, case tracking systems, client intake portals, document management, and billing tools
- **Accounting Firms** — financial operations software, reconciliation tools, client dashboards, reporting systems, and workflow automation
- **General** — custom dashboards, internal tools, process automation, and marketing websites for SMEs and MSMEs

## What makes Acqron different

- We learn the specific workflows of your industry before writing a single line of code
- We build working MVPs in an average of 8 weeks from kickoff
- We train your team until they can run the software independently
- We have a 100% client satisfaction rate across all engagements
- We are honest about trade-offs — we will tell you when something is not worth building

## Our track record

Acqron has shipped software for clients across the United States and the Philippines, including vacation rental platforms, real estate investment tools, short-term rental management systems, AI automation platforms, and construction company websites.

## Services

1. Property & Rental Management Tools
2. Law Firm Practice Software
3. Accounting & Finance Operations Software
4. Workflow & Process Automation
5. Dashboards, Reporting & Analytics
6. Website & Landing Page Development
